capabilities.name: generate_blog_post
capabilities.description: Generate full blog posts or pages from a topic, keywords, or outline
examples: I need a blog post about AI in marketing
Create a post for small business owners about SEO

capabilities.name: seo_audit_and_optimize
capabilities.description: Perform comprehensive SEO analysis on existing or generated content

capabilities.name: research_topic
capabilities.description: Conduct in-depth research on a topic including competitors, trends, and key facts
examples: Research the current state of DeFi
What are the latest trend in cloud computing?

capabilities.name: publish_to_wordpress
capabilities.description: Connect to WordPress instance and publish or update posts/pages
examples: Push this to my blog as a draft

capabilities.name: generate_image_asset
capabilities.description: Generate high-quality image assets using fal.ai for posts and featured images
examples: Generate a featured image for a blog post about AI
Create a 16:9 illustration of a robot doctor
